entries.title: Table 1. Design Parameters for AMAC Compressor.
entries.notes: High-speed parent compressor, not the LSRC. Two-column table; units are inside the parameter labels, so row 2 is blank. Second cell-by-cell read from the zoomed image done. The table prints no column headings; row 1 is left blank (was 'PARAMETER,VALUE', supplied by the first transcriber). Third, independent cell-by-cell read from fresh 300-dpi renders by the verifying agent (2026-10-08), plus consistency checks (camber vs metal angles, i/δ vs vector diagrams, β' vs atan(Vθ/Vz)): no transcription error found.

entries.title: Table 2. Design Parameters for AMAC Stage 7 and the Low Speed Stage A.
entries.notes: Footnotes: † 'The flow coefficient was computed as the average rotor inlet axial velocity divided by the rotor pitch speed, using the full physical annulus area (blockage = 1.0). Based on the rotor tip speed, this flow coefficient becomes 0.407.' ‡ 'The pressure coefficient was computed by using the rotor pitchline wheel speed. Based on rotor tip speed, this value becomes 0.555.' Cell 'Pressure-Rise Coefficient / AMAC Stage 7' read 0.638 with the last digit ambiguous (3 or 8; text layer says 0.633). Second cell-by-cell read from the zoomed image done. Third, independent cell-by-cell read from fresh 300-dpi renders by the verifying agent (2026-10-08), plus consistency checks (camber vs metal angles, i/δ vs vector diagrams, β' vs atan(Vθ/Vz)): no transcription error found.

entries.title: Table 3. Vector Diagram Parameters for AMAC Stage 7 and Stage A.
entries.notes: Page rotated; read after rotating 90 deg. Stage 7 radii printed '-'. Printed values kept although two look like misprints: Rotor Inlet V'θ SL4 Stg.A = 42.25 (tan(β')·Vz gives about 45.2), Rotor Exit V'θ SL9 Stg.A = 29.52 (sequence suggests 20.52). Footnote '† SL ≡ Streamline'. Second cell-by-cell read from the zoomed image done. Further printed inconsistency: Rotor Exit β' Pitch SL6 Stg.7 = 46.2 while atan(172.4/178.2) = 44.0; all three cells re-checked in the image and kept as printed. Rotor Inlet U SL10 = 49.98 at r = 66.0 (U/r of the other columns gives 49.90); kept. Third, independent cell-by-cell read from fresh 300-dpi renders by the verifying agent (2026-10-08), plus consistency checks (camber vs metal angles, i/δ vs vector diagrams, β' vs atan(Vθ/Vz)): no transcription error found.

entries.title: Table 6. Stator 7 and Stator A Airfoil Geometry.
entries.notes: Rotated page. Column headings printed 'OD S7', 'SA', 'SL2† SA', ..., 'Pitch S7', 'SA', ..., 'ID S7', 'SA' (no SL1/SL6/SL11 labels). Hub (ID SA) radius printed 67.770; every other table gives 64.770 at the hub, so 67.770 is probably a misprint, kept as printed. Row label printed 'Avg. Radius, r (cm' (parenthesis missing). Second cell-by-cell read from the zoomed image done. Printed deviations at SL5 SA (6.69) and Pitch SA (6.16) disagree with Table 3 (β2 - β2* = 6.96 and 6.60; digit transpositions in the source?); re-checked in the image, kept as printed. Third, independent cell-by-cell read from fresh 300-dpi renders by the verifying agent (2026-10-08), plus consistency checks (camber vs metal angles, i/δ vs vector diagrams, β' vs atan(Vθ/Vz)): no transcription error found.

entries.title: Table 7. Rotor B Airfoil Geometry.
entries.notes: Rotated page. Hub radius printed 67.770 (probable misprint for 64.770). Second cell-by-cell read from the zoomed image done. Printed Camber row SL2-SL9 is shifted by one column relative to β1*-β2* (computed 30.20, 30.15, 30.49, 31.05, 31.80, 32.80, 34.00, 35.70; printed 30.26, 30.20, 30.15, 30.49, 31.05, 31.80, 32.80, 34.00); Stagger SL6-SL9 (51.66, 50.36, 49.18, 47.87) looks similarly shifted against Rotor A (Rotor A SL6-SL9: 50.36, 49.18, 47.87, 46.5). Re-checked in the image: this is how the source prints it. Incidence/deviation agree with Table 3 (Stage A vector diagrams), not Table 4. Third, independent cell-by-cell read from fresh 300-dpi renders by the verifying agent (2026-10-08), plus consistency checks (camber vs metal angles, i/δ vs vector diagrams, β' vs atan(Vθ/Vz)): no transcription error found.

Third, independent cell-by-cell read from fresh 300-dpi renders by the verifying agent (2026-10-08), plus consistency checks (camber vs metal angles, i/δ vs vector diagrams, β' vs atan(Vθ/Vz)): no transcription error found.

entries.title: Table 9. Stator C Airfoil Geometry.
entries.notes: Rotated page. Chord at SL3 printed 3.799 (probably 8.799); hub radius printed 67.770 (probably 64.770). Camber = β1* - β2* - ΔCAM_LE - ΔCAM_TE. Second cell-by-cell read from the zoomed image done. SL3: printed β1* = 54.50, but incidence (-7.37) and camber (47.40 = β1*-β2*-ΔCAM_LE-ΔCAM_TE) both imply β1* = 56.47-56.50; printed t_max/c SL2 = 0.081 breaks the 0.090/0.087/0.084 sequence (Stator B SL2 is 0.087). All re-checked in the image; kept as printed. Incidence/deviation otherwise agree with Table 3 (Stage A stator inlet/exit). Third, independent cell-by-cell read from fresh 300-dpi renders by the verifying agent (2026-10-08), plus consistency checks (camber vs metal angles, i/δ vs vector diagrams, β' vs atan(Vθ/Vz)): no transcription error found.
